analyst_view.overall: Braga (17th, 4 pts) host KuPS (33rd, 1 pt) and need the win to move toward the top 24. Under Franclim Carvalho, who took over in October and switched to a 4-2-3-1 with a fixed striker, Braga have won four in a row without conceding, the last a 2-0 cup win at Vitoria de Guimaraes on Saturday with goals from Horta and Navarro. Sikou Niakate (Achilles) is out and already counted; striker Jonas Wind is doubtful with physical overload, which the numbers don't count, but Navarro, Horta and Pau Victor are expected to start and Gabriel Silva is back. KuPS have not won in six or seven games, their Finnish season is over so they arrive short of competitive football, and winger Bob Nii Armah is doubtful (counted). Ukrainian referee Oleksiy Derevinskyi is named, and the numbers already trim cards a little for his record.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals, about 2.1 of them Braga's. I lean a little higher: KuPS' league season is over and they arrive without competitive rhythm and without a win in six, which the numbers can't see, while Braga's attack is scoring again under Franclim even if Wind misses out. A mild +4% gives about 2.7 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, about 7 for Braga, already lifted 9% for Braga's recent corner count and cut for KuPS' few. KuPS will mostly defend deep, which the split already reflects, so I stay at about 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards, already trimmed for both sides' quiet recent discipline and for referee Derevinskyi's low card count (-3%). A one-sided game against a team defending deep usually stays calm, which is what the numbers show, so I stay at about 3.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.8 shots, already pushed up 26% for Braga's recent shot volume and down 13% for KuPS'. KuPS' lack of rhythm argues for even more Braga pressure, but Braga played a cup tie on Saturday and may rotate, and the numbers already carry a big lift, so I stay at about 29.8.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target, 7.5 of them Braga's. A KuPS side out of season should give up cleaner chances than usual, which the numbers can't see, and Navarro is scoring again in Franclim's set-up, so I lean slightly higher: +3% gives about 10.4.
